name: list_files
label: List files
summary: List the selected code and skill folders and their contents.

name: read_file
label: Read file
summary: Read a file or a line range from a code or skill folder.

name: search_files
label: Search files
summary: Find literal text in code and skill folders with ripgrep.

name: shell_run
label: Shell
summary: Run Bash, rg, ast-grep, git, Python and skill scripts in an isolated sandbox.

name: code_search
label: Code search
summary: Find functions by name with their bodies and calls.

name: ast_grep
label: Structural search
summary: Match syntax patterns with ast-grep.

name: code_graph
label: Code graph
summary: Search symbols and follow callers and callees. Offered when a selected code project has a generated graph.

name: ssh_run
label: SSH
summary: Run a command on a selected server.

name: get_available_resources
label: Available resources
summary: The resources this run may use, optionally of one type.

name: get_resource
label: Resource info
summary: What is recorded about a server, service, environment or code project.

name: get_environment_model
label: Environment model
summary: One environment's servers, deployments, services, connections, external services and relations.

name: list_servers
label: List servers
summary: The servers in an environment, with their environments.

name: list_deployments
label: List deployments
summary: The deployments on a server or of a service.

name: list_connections
label: List connections
summary: The connections of a service or a deployment.

name: save_environment
label: Save environment
summary: Draft an environment, or update a draft environment.

name: save_server
label: Save server
summary: Draft a server, or update a draft server; optionally put it in an environment.

name: save_service
label: Save service
summary: Draft a service, or update a draft service.

name: save_deployment
label: Save deployment
summary: Draft a deployment, or update a draft deployment.

name: save_connection
label: Save connection
summary: Draft a connection to a deployment, an external service or a host, or update a draft connection.

name: save_relation
label: Save relation
summary: Draft a service relation, or update a draft relation.

name: remove_inventory_item
label: Remove inventory item
summary: Remove a draft environment, server, service, deployment, connection or relation.

name: save_inventory_draft
label: Save inventory draft
summary: Draft an environment, servers, services, deployments, connections and relations in one call, by name.

name: get_document
label: Read document
summary: Read a document (this run's draft of it, if any) given to this run or linked to a resource in it.

name: search_documents
label: Search documents
summary: Find published documents by words, with a snippet of each.

name: list_documents
label: List documents
summary: The documents of a server, service or environment, with this run's drafts.

name: new_document
label: New document
summary: Draft a new document for a server, service or environment.

name: update_document
label: Update a document
summary: Save this run's draft of a document with its whole new text.

name: edit_document
label: Edit a document
summary: Replace one passage in this run's draft of a document.

name: search_memory
label: Search memory
summary: Find what agents saved before, by words, meaning, metadata or agent.

name: get_memory
label: Read a memory
summary: Read one memory entry in full.

name: save_memory
label: Save a memory
summary: Save a new fact or procedure under a unique name.

name: update_memory
label: Update a memory
summary: Replace an entry with a merged version (revision-checked).

name: run_subagent
label: Start subagents
summary: Hand a separate part of the work to a helper that runs in parallel.

name: schedule_wakeup
label: Schedule a wake-up
summary: Continue this session later with a message to itself.

name: list_wakeups
label: List wake-ups
summary: This session's pending wake-ups.

name: cancel_wakeup
label: Cancel a wake-up
summary: Cancel a pending wake-up of this session.
